page.overview:
Who is Sun Rooster of Hairy Head?

The is a member of the Twenty-Eight Constellations embodying the mansion of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hairy_Head Hairy Head].

The Sun Rooster of Hairy Head wore a golden five-fold cap, an eight-treasure belt, and a pendant. He carried a jade tablet and a seven-star sword.

At Guanyin's request, Sun Wukong went up to Heaven to get the Sun Rooster of Hairy Head to help him defeat the Scorpion Spirit. The Sun Rooster transformed into his true form as a giant rooster and crowed twice, killing the demon.

The Sun Rooster of Hairy Head can transform from his human form back into his true form, which is a giant seven-foot-tall double-combed rooster. In this form, one crow will revert any insect-based demon back to its true form, and a second crow will kill them.
